title: camellia ilicifolia var. neriifolia
intro: Camellia ilicifolia var. neriifolia, commonly known as the Holly-leaf camellia, is a plant species within the Camellia genus. It is a type of evergreen shrub native to China, known for its ornamental value and potential medicinal uses. The health benefits of Camellia ilicifolia var. neriifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and modulate the immune system, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
